items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: So we made a session, and we made a good session at that time, and I got a contract.

ctx.x: Well, you said something about being in New York, the first...like since 1939. I remember that's the first New Orleans band I really heard in person. That was 1936 when you were up at Nick's. Remember down there? You go down a few steps to the old Nick's on 7th Avenue.

That's right. It was in 1939. It was...when I went to New York, it was 1936. When I went to work for Nick, it was going into 1937. Yeah. In other words, this is how I got to New York. I just finished a place called the Chapery. It's right out here in West End. It's now the Maison Restaurant. Oh yeah. This was the Chapery. It was run by Joe Loicana, Steve Loicana, and Angelo Gemelli. They had a nightclub. And it was a pretty big place. Yeah. And at that time, they had a woman by the name of Ming Toy. She was a…
Is Harry James one of those names?
